The CTP module dynamically reorders tokens based on their feature similarity, aiming to group semantically related tokens together, thus facilitating more efficient compression. This is achieved through a codebook-based clustering approach, where tokens are assigned to clusters based on their cosine similarity to learned centroids. The GPP module, on the other hand, injects sample-specific global priors into the SSM, relaxing its strict causality and enabling the model to capture long-range dependencies more effectively.
